name: Elfia Haarzuilens
blurb: A fantasy and cosplay festival formerly held at Castle de Haar in Haarzuilens, Netherlands, discontinued after its final 2025 edition.
notes: Dutch fan-event press (fantasywereld.nl: 'Elfia in 2025 nog een laatste maal in Haarzuilens' / kastelenmagazine.nl: 'Het doek valt voor Elfia bij Kasteel de Haar') both report that 2025 was the last Elfia at Castle de Haar. The official site now confirms the move: elfia.com's own Programme page only lists 'Castle Vorden' and 'Arcen Castle Gardens' as venues, with a 'Vorden 2027 Ticket' on sale, and no Haarzuilens edition or date anywhere on the site. Treated as discontinued/inactive at this location; the brand continues at Castle Vorden (not in this batch) and at Arcen (see elfia-arcen).
